offers_products.reason: Designs and sells audio codecs, smart amplifiers, converters and haptic mixed-signal ICs, with manufacturing outsourced.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from chips; engineering support and tools only accompany product sales.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells ICs to device makers (smartphone, PC, automotive brands), not to individuals directly.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are electronics brands and manufacturers building smartphones, laptops, automotive and industrial products.

recurring_revenue.reason: Sales are design-win-based chip orders to device makers, tied to product cycles rather than contracts or subscriptions.

cyclical_demand.reason: Chip demand follows consumer electronics sales like smartphones and laptops, which fall in downturns.

big_ticket.reason: Individual ICs are low-priced components bought in high volume, though design wins are significant.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for semiconductor products and technology, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main customers are large global consumer electronics brands (smartphone, PC makers) and automotive manufacturers.

asset_heavy.reason: Fabless model; manufacturing, assembly and test are outsourced to global suppliers.
